reason: The cited evidence does not address CSRO formation in HfNbTaTiZr, its effect on dislocation cores, or its influence on elastic moduli and thermal expansion. E1 concerns a different alloy (NbTaHfTiZrV0.5) and does not mention CSRO; E2 reports age softening in Ti-V-Nb-Ta, contradicting the predicted hardening; E3 discusses lattice distortion and shear modulus in TiZrNbHfTa but does not link these to CSRO or thermal expansion. Thus, the key premises lack specific prior support.
premises: Annealing at ~600 °C induces chemical short-range order (CSRO) in HfNbTaTiZr
CSRO alters dislocation core structures and interatomic bonding
CSRO increases yield strength and reduces creep rates
CSRO modifies elastic moduli and thermal expansion coefficients
A rapidly quenched state is fully disordered with minimal CSRO
